in_latin.name: Elouisa
in_latin.long_meaning: Elouisa, nomen femininum, significat 'Dei amorem', quod derivatur ex 'El' (Deus) et 'Luis' (amor). In traditione Christiana, nomen 'El-Luis' (Dei amor) est usitatum, et significat 'amorem Dei'.

in_english.name: Elouise
in_english.meaning: Elouise means God is my riches, love of God, or God's gift
in_english.long_meaning: Elouise is a feminine given name derived from the Hebrew 'El' (God) and 'Luis' (love). In Christian tradition, Elouise is used to signify 'God's love' or 'God's gift.' Etymologically, the name Elouise is associated with the biblical concept of agape love, which emphasizes selfless and unconditional love for others. In modern times, Elouise is used as a variant of the name Louise, which is derived from the Germanic word 'hluess,' meaning 'renowned warrior' or 'famous battle.'
